source: Peak VRAM measurements in benchmark results

analysis.native: Native HiGS uses slightly LESS VRAM than std (-0.04 GB); packed FP16 scene buffers vs std's FP32 visible-subset storage
analysis.dynamic: Dynamic uses +0.41 GB due to densify temporaries (new Gaussians, gradient accumulation, optimizer state for new rows)

analysis.native: Native uses +0.75 GB MORE VRAM; FP32 captured state (means2D, conics, colors_eval, opacities, isects, alphas) for native backward vs std's autograd-saved tensors
analysis.dynamic: Dynamic uses +3.75 GB; densify temporaries + optimizer state for 2x N (peak before prune) + resolution-scaling visibility lists

high_res_1080p.notes: Dynamic VRAM grows significantly at 1080p (+8.92 GB vs std)

std_bicycle_960x540.total_estimate: 1.45 + 2.90 + 1.36 + 1.8 = 7.51 GB (measured 10.39 GB includes allocator overhead, fragmentation, temporaries)

LOW_N_1M.notes: Native slightly better; packed FP16 offsets captured state

HIGH_N_6M.notes: Native worse; captured state (FP32) + packed buffers (FP16) exceed std's autograd saved

scaling_exponent.std: 1.8x N -> 3.2x VRAM (slightly super-linear due to workspace)
scaling_exponent.higs_native: 1.8x N -> 3.5x VRAM (worse scaling due to dual representation)

bicycle_1080p.notes: Resolution has small impact; memory dominated by Gaussian state, not pixels

vs_resolution.conclusion: Memory scales weakly with resolution; strongly with N

vs_camera_batch.not_measured: Batch scaling memory not separately reported
vs_camera_batch.inference: Memory should scale linearly with batch (more isects, more render outputs)
vs_camera_batch.estimate: B4 vs B1: +3x isects, +3x render buffers -> ~+2-3 GB expected

key_findings.memory_advantage: NOT PRESENT - HiGS native uses slightly MORE VRAM than std for HIGH-N scenes
key_findings.reason: Dual representation (FP32 captured state for native backward + FP16 packed scene for culling)
key_findings.LOW_N_exception: For LOW-N, packed FP16 savings offset captured state cost
key_findings.dynamic_penalty: Dynamic topology adds +3.75 GB (bicycle) due to densify temporaries
key_findings.scaling_behavior: HiGS memory scales slightly worse than std with N
key_findings.implication: Memory is NOT a selling point for Trainable HiGS in current implementation
key_findings.potential_improvement: If tile LOD realized (30M macro-tile entries vs 330M isects), memory could improve by ~10x for isect storage

evidence_labels.DERIVED: Memory breakdowns (from tensor shapes and dtypes)
evidence_labels.UNRESOLVED: Exact allocator overhead breakdown; batch scaling memory
